notes: NOT CALIBRATED. The two dense bars are measured, not guessed: a live run over the committed corpus with real BGE-M3 gave max_dense 0.501-0.631 for answerable questions and 0.359-0.451 for unanswerable ones, and both bars clear the irrelevant band. min_dense_alone is the higher of the two because that branch has no corroborating coverage -- it exists for the cross-lingual case, where coverage is structurally zero because there are no shared tokens (D47). min_coverage_high is higher than min_coverage so the lexical branch is the stricter of the two. EVIDENCE LIMIT: 18 questions, hand-picked, mostly from a 7-chunk Persian PDF. That is enough to reject a guess that sat inside the answerable range and not enough to call anything calibrated. P9 grid-searches on the dev split and rewrites this file with calibrated=true. Thresholds are keyed on model_id and a mismatched file is refused, never reused.
